# Anime.js homepage model assets

These GLB files were fetched from the public model paths used by the Anime.js
homepage on 2026-07-17:

`https://animejs.com/assets/models/module-*.glb`

The files are used here to reproduce the homepage-style Three.js engine demo.
The Anime.js library is MIT licensed, but the website does not expose a separate
asset license alongside these model URLs. Confirm reuse rights before publishing
or redistributing the model files outside this project.
